upstream.description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.

classification.analysis: Voicebox is a local-first AI voice studio desktop app (Tauri + React with a Python FastAPI sidecar) for voice cloning, speech generation across 7 local TTS engines (Qwen3-TTS, LuxTTS, Chatterbox, HumeAI TADA, Kokoro), local Whisper transcription, and system-wide global-hotkey dictation with LLM text refinement — positioned as an offline alternative to ElevenLabs and Wispr Flow. It ships a REST API and a first-class MCP server (speak/transcribe tools plus a stdio shim) so coding agents can use voice I/O, plus a multi-voice Stories timeline editor and an audio effects chain. MIT-licensed with ~52k stars and 77 contributors; prebuilt Windows MSI and macOS DMG, Docker for Linux/headless; release cadence paused since April 2026 with maintainer activity continuing in bursts.

use_cases.title: Clone a voice and generate speech fully offline
Give coding agents voice I/O via its MCP server
Dictate into any app with a global hotkey and local Whisper
Produce multi-voice narrated audio with the Stories timeline editor
